journey.title: Correct a mistake and keep the record
journey.purpose: The path that proves the economy is teachable rather than arbitrary: a wrong grant is corrected without any history being erased.

steps.intent: The minter finds the event that was wrong and sees who caused it and whether they were verified.
The minter observes that no edit or delete affordance exists anywhere on the page.
The minter issues a compensating correction with a reason rather than removing the original.
The correction appears linked to the original, and both remain visible.
The holder sees both the mistake and its correction, which is what makes the economy trustworthy to them.

claims.statement: No surface in this journey offers deletion of a journal event.
claims.rationale: The append-only contract is a product promise, not only a storage detail.
